articles.title: Sensex, Nifty extend gains despite oil hovering near $115/barrel. What lies ahead?
articles.description: The Indian stock market nudged upward on Tuesday, with Sensex and Nifty making modest gains despite lingering challenges. Investors remained cautious due to high oil prices, which are currently at $115 per barrel. However, a notable surge in smallcap stocks is enhancing investor confidence. Analysts attribute this positive momentum to better corporate fundamentals and increased domestic fund inflows.

articles.title: US futures and Asian stocks advance following a rally on Wall Street
articles.description: Asian stocks are mostly higher, with benchmarks in Tokyo and Seoul lifted by buying of AI-related stocks. U.S. futures edged higher and oil prices extended losses. South Korea’s Kospi jumped 4.3%, with strong gains for computer chipmakers SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics. Japan’s Nikkei 225 gained 2%, while shares in Hong Kong and Shanghai edged lower. Investors face a busy week, with earnings reports from about one-third of S&P 500 companies and interest rate decisions by the Federal Reserve and other big central banks. On Monday, the S&P 500 rose 0.7% and more than recovered its losses from last week. The Dow Jones Industrial Average added 0.3%, and the Nasdaq composite climbed 0.8%.
